groupings.title: Start here
groupings.description: One command from a title to a reviewed visual: /illustrate briefs the idea, routes it to Mermaid or a slide-like SVG, draws it in a subagent, and reviews the result.

groupings.title: Brief and route
groupings.description: Turns a title, notes, or a hot take into a one-page brief with the single takeaway and the format that the destination can actually show.

groupings.title: Diagrams-as-code
groupings.description: Mermaid and DOT that render on the first try and still read as a diagram: pinned config, quoted labels, a node cap, lint, validate, render.

groupings.title: Slide-like illustrations
groupings.description: Social cards, article heroes, and slide visuals compiled from a small JSON spec onto a fixed grid, so the model never places a coordinate.

groupings.title: Review
groupings.description: Deterministic lints, a feed-size render, and an analyze-then-judge checklist that returns PASS, FIX, or REDRAW instead of a vibe.
